high_level_description: This image appears to be a selfie taken by a person standing in front of an oval-shaped mirror. The person is holding a smartphone with both hands, taking the photo. They have long, dark hair and are wearing a sleeveless, ribbed, light brown top paired with a denim mini skirt. The individual also has a brown shoulder bag slung over their left shoulder. The background features a wall painted in a light greenish-blue color. There are some decorative elements on the wall, including what looks like coral and a goldfish illustration, adding a playful and artistic touch to the setting.
